apis.name: Open Library API
apis.why_notable: Internet Archive’s free book metadata, search, and cover API with no key required for most reads.

apis.name: iTunes Search API
apis.why_notable: Apple’s free, keyless catalog search for music, movies, TV, podcasts, and audiobooks.

apis.name: Deezer API
apis.why_notable: Full music catalog search, albums, artists, and playlists with a generous free public API.

apis.name: Fanart.tv API
apis.why_notable: High-quality fan-made movie, TV, and music artwork keyed by TMDB/TVDB/MusicBrainz IDs.

apis.name: TheTVDB API
apis.why_notable: Long-standing TV series/episode metadata standard used by many media servers and scrapers.

apis.name: Giant Bomb API
apis.why_notable: Video game encyclopedia API with games, characters, reviews, and company data.

apis.name: BoardGameGeek XML API
apis.why_notable: Canonical board-game metadata, ratings, and collection data via public XML endpoints.

apis.name: Comic Vine API
apis.why_notable: Largest comic-book encyclopedia API covering issues, volumes, characters, and publishers.
